name: atlanai-analytics
description: Build an agent that answers your data questions, on a demo or your own data: I extract the context in your dashboards and past queries, add detailed information to it and validate it, then you store it here or save it to Atlan Trident, ask it questions and build a dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Build an agent that answers your data questions
interface.longDescription: The analytics workload on Atlan Trident, as seven skills. analytics-demo walks through a made-up firm end to end. analytics-build does the same on your own data, starting from nothing, a dashboard or a subject: it surveys what you already have, asks what you want to answer, and builds from dashboards first, then past queries, then table definitions. source-survey says what a setup, a subject or a source holds, what can be built from it, and which metric names it offers. metrics-generation builds, tests, edits, proposes and saves metrics and saved queries. analytics-ask answers a data question from saved metrics, names what each answer is based on, and turns answers into a dashboard. eval-generation turns the questions a team already asks into test questions with known answers, kept here or saved to Atlan Trident. accuracy-check tests your agent on those questions and scores it, saying why each miss failed. It finds your Snowflake, Databricks or other warehouse through Atlan or your own connector, and uses the Atlan plugin's connection.
defaultPrompt: Show me an Atlan Analytics demo
Help me use this dashboard, folder or BI export to ask questions about my data
Build metrics and saved queries for our support tables from the warehouse's past queries
